prompt:
The harness supplies one local ROOT file. Its event object is Records_7; ID column id_7:int64, energy column energy_7:float64 [GeV], object pT collection objects_pt_7:var * float64 [GeV], declared count nobjects_7:int32, signed MC weight weight_7:float64. String provenance has saved cycles. Actual values must be read from the file. All outputs use new harness-controlled paths.
Available operations and required JSON arguments (plus operation):
class(object): Return the ROOT class name of object.
cycles(object): Return stored string versions of object in increasing cycle order.
select_gt(tree, column, threshold, id_column): Return IDs where scalar column > threshold.
select_range(tree, column, low, high, id_column): Return IDs where low <= scalar column < high.
jagged_count_gt(tree, column, threshold): Return per-row counts of collection elements > threshold, retaining empty rows.
jagged_sum(tree, column): Return scalar sum of collection elements per row, zero for empty rows.
weighted_hist(tree, column, weight, edges): Return sumw and sumw2 in edges; NumPy bin convention, discard flow; independent entries.
selected_yield(tree, column, threshold, weight): Return entries and sumw where column > threshold.
stream_sum(tree, column, threshold, weight, chunk_entries): Return sumw where column > threshold, reading chunk_entries rows per chunk.
check_counts(tree, column, count, id_column): Return IDs where count differs from per-row length of collection column.
write_skim(tree, column, threshold, id_column): Write new Selected TTree with id_column and column where column > threshold; reopen and return class and IDs.
write_hist(tree, column, edges): Write new unweighted histogram of column with edges, reopen and return values and edges.
